test_GroupNorm_basic: test the GroupNorm class with basic channel-last inputs and no scale or offset
test_GroupNorm_NCHW: test the GroupNorm class with NCHW data format and learnable scale and offset parameters
test_GroupNorm_data_format_agnostic: test the GroupNorm class produces identical outputs for channel-last and channel-first data formats
test_GroupNorm_tensor_params: test the GroupNorm class with externally provided scale and offset tensors at call time
test_GroupNorm_invalid_inputs: test the GroupNorm class raises ValueError for invalid data formats, axis types, and incompatible group counts
